n5.note: A core beginner kanji used for days, dates, and Japan itself.

n5.example: 月曜日 / げつようび / Monday
n5.note: Used for the moon, calendar months, and weekday names.

n5.example: 木曜日 / もくようび / Thursday
n5.note: Picture a tree trunk with branches. It appears in wood, trees, and Thursday.

n5.example: 水曜日 / すいようび / Wednesday
n5.note: Think of water flowing outward from the middle stroke.

n5.example: 火曜日 / かようび / Tuesday
n5.note: Part of the weekday cycle and many fire or heat words.

n5.example: 日本人 / にほんじん / Japanese person
n5.note: Two simple strokes form a standing person.

n5.example: 学生 / がくせい / student
n5.note: A must-know school and learning kanji.

n5.example: 富士山 / ふじさん / Mt. Fuji
n5.note: The shape looks like mountain peaks.

n4.example: 駅前 / えきまえ / in front of the station
n4.note: A practical travel kanji. Look for it on maps and train signs.

n4.example: 電車 / でんしゃ / train
n4.note: Electric rain over a field: electricity powers trains and devices.

n4.example: 北海道 / ほっかいどう / Hokkaido
n4.note: A path radical plus a head: the way someone walks.

n4.example: 会社 / かいしゃ / company
n4.note: Useful for meetings, groups, and communities.

n4.example: 店員 / てんいん / shop clerk
n4.note: A practical kanji for stores and shopping.

n4.example: 買い物 / かいもの / shopping
n4.note: One of the most useful daily-life action kanji.

n4.example: 旅行 / りょこう / trip

n4.note: Shows up in family and group identity words.

n3.example: 経験がある / けいけんがある / to have experience
n3.note: Common in work, life stories, and introductions.

n3.example: 自然環境 / しぜんかんきょう / natural environment
n3.note: Useful for news, school essays, and society topics.

n3.example: 日本文化 / にほんぶんか / Japanese culture
n3.note: A core word for society and identity.

n3.example: 歴史を学ぶ / れきしをまなぶ / study history
n3.note: Useful in school, travel, and culture contexts.

n3.example: 事故の原因 / じこのげんいん / cause of an accident
n3.note: Very common for explanations and news.

n3.example: 試験の結果 / しけんのけっか / exam result
n3.note: Pairs naturally with cause, effort, and tests.

n3.example: 連絡する / れんらくする / to contact
n3.note: Daily practical word for messaging someone.

n3.example: 準備できた / じゅんびできた / ready
n3.note: Common for events, school, travel, and work.

n2.example: 責任を持つ / せきにんをもつ / take responsibility
n2.note: Important for work, school, and serious conversations.

n2.example: 教育制度 / きょういくせいど / education system
n2.note: Appears in society, news, and policy topics.

n2.example: 自然資源 / しぜんしげん / natural resources
n2.note: Useful for environment and economics vocabulary.

n2.example: 高く評価する / たかくひょうかする / to value highly
n2.note: Common in school, work, reviews, and opinions.

n2.example: 日本の技術 / にほんのぎじゅつ / Japanese technology
n2.note: A strong N2 word for ability and technical fields.

n2.example: 複雑な問題 / ふくざつなもんだい / complex problem
n2.note: A useful adjective for systems, feelings, and problems.

n2.example: 問題を解決する / もんだいをかいけつする / solve a problem
n2.note: Pairs naturally with problems and conflict.

n2.example: 大きな影響 / おおきなえいきょう / major influence
n2.note: Very common in essays, news, and analysis.

n1.example: 基本的な概念 / きほんてきながいねん / basic concept
n1.note: Abstract academic vocabulary for explanations and theory.

n1.example: 矛盾している / むじゅんしている / be contradictory
n1.note: A high-level logic and argument word.

n1.example: 抽象的な表現 / ちゅうしょうてきなひょうげん / abstract expression
n1.note: Useful for academic writing and discussion.

n1.example: 妥協点を探す / だきょうてんをさがす / seek a compromise
n1.note: Common in negotiations and social topics.

n1.example: 偏見をなくす / へんけんをなくす / eliminate prejudice
n1.note: Important for social discussion and essays.

n1.example: 国の繁栄 / くにのはんえい / national prosperity
n1.note: A formal word often used in speeches and writing.

n1.example: 謙虚な態度 / けんきょなたいど / humble attitude
n1.note: A respected personality word in formal contexts.

n1.example: 顕著な変化 / けんちょなへんか / remarkable change
n1.note: Great for advanced observation and analysis.
